{"tools":[
{"name":"create_social_post","description":"Creates a draft social media post for one platform, with caption, optional media and hashtags. Use it to prepare content; it does not publish or schedule the post.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"platform":{"type":"string","enum":["instagram","facebook","tiktok","x","pinterest"]},"caption":{"type":"string"},"media_urls":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"hashtags":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"campaign_id":{"type":"string","description":"Optional campaign to attach the post to"}},"required":["platform","caption"]},"request":"Draft an Instagram post announcing our new summer sandals collection with the caption 'Summer steps start here' and the hashtags #sandals and #summerstyle."},
{"name":"schedule_social_post","description":"Schedules an existing draft social post to publish at a specific date and time. Use it once the draft is approved and you know when it should go live.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"post_id":{"type":"string"},"publish_at":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"timezone":{"type":"string","description":"IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin"}},"required":["post_id","publish_at"]},"request":"Schedule draft post p_8841 to go live this Friday at 9am."},
{"name":"list_scheduled_posts","description":"Lists social posts that are scheduled but not yet published, optionally filtered by platform and date range. Use it to review the upcoming content calendar.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"platform":{"type":"string","enum":["instagram","facebook","tiktok","x","pinterest"]},"from_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"to_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100}},"required":[]},"request":"What do we have scheduled on Facebook for next week?"},
{"name":"cancel_scheduled_post","description":"Cancels a scheduled social post so it will not be published, returning it to draft status. Use it when a post is outdated or has an error.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"post_id":{"type":"string"},"reason":{"type":"string"}},"required":["post_id"]},"request":"Pull the scheduled TikTok post p_7720 back to draft, the flash sale it mentions was cancelled."},
{"name":"get_social_post_metrics","description":"Returns engagement metrics for a single published post: impressions, reach, likes, comments, shares, clicks and saves. Use it to judge how one specific post performed.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"post_id":{"type":"string"},"include_hourly_breakdown":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["post_id"]},"request":"How many likes, shares and link clicks did our Instagram post p_8312 get?"},
{"name":"reply_to_social_comment","description":"Posts a public reply to a comment on one of the shop's social posts. Use it for community management, such as answering product questions.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"post_id":{"type":"string"},"comment_id":{"type":"string"},"reply_text":{"type":"string"}},"required":["post_id","comment_id","reply_text"]},"request":"Reply to comment c_55120 on our Instagram post saying the linen shirt is back in stock on Monday."},
{"name":"create_promotion","description":"Creates a storefront promotion such as a percentage off, fixed amount off, BOGO or free shipping, applied automatically to eligible products or collections within a date range. Use it for sales that do not require a code.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"type":{"type":"string","enum":["percentage_off","amount_off","buy_x_get_y","free_shipping"]},"value":{"type":"number","description":"Percent or currency amount; ignored for free_shipping"},"applies_to":{"type":"object","properties":{"product_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"collection_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}}},"starts_at":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"ends_at":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"min_order_value":{"type":"number"}},"required":["name","type","starts_at"]},"request":"Set up a 20% off promotion on the Outerwear collection from November 24 to November 30 called Black Week Coats."},
{"name":"update_promotion","description":"Changes the settings of an existing promotion, such as its discount value, dates, or eligible collections. Use it to adjust a promotion without recreating it.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"promotion_id":{"type":"string"},"name":{"type":"string"},"value":{"type":"number"},"ends_at":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"min_order_value":{"type":"number"},"collection_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["promotion_id"]},"request":"Extend the Black Week Coats promotion promo_204 until December 2 at midnight."},
{"name":"end_promotion","description":"Immediately ends an active or scheduled promotion so it no longer applies at checkout. Use it to stop a sale early.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"promotion_id":{"type":"string"},"reason":{"type":"string"}},"required":["promotion_id"]},"request":"Stop the free shipping promotion promo_198 right now, we're running low on stock."},
{"name":"list_active_promotions","description":"Lists promotions that are currently live or scheduled, with type, value, dates and eligible items. Use it to see what discounts customers can get right now.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"status":{"type":"string","enum":["active","scheduled","expired","all"]},"type":{"type":"string","enum":["percentage_off","amount_off","buy_x_get_y","free_shipping"]}},"required":[]},"request":"Which promotions are running on the store at the moment?"},
{"name":"create_discount_code","description":"Creates a single discount code that customers enter at checkout, with value, usage limits and expiry. Use it for one named code like a newsletter welcome offer or an influencer code.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"code":{"type":"string"},"discount_type":{"type":"string","enum":["percentage","fixed_amount","free_shipping"]},"value":{"type":"number"},"max_redemptions":{"type":"integer"},"one_use_per_customer":{"type":"boolean"},"min_order_value":{"type":"number"},"expires_at":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"}},"required":["code","discount_type"]},"request":"Create a discount code WELCOME10 for 10% off, one use per customer, expiring at the end of the year."},
{"name":"bulk_generate_discount_codes","description":"Generates many unique single-use discount codes sharing the same rules, with a common prefix. Use it for mailing lists, event giveaways or partner distribution.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"prefix":{"type":"string"},"quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":10000},"discount_type":{"type":"string","enum":["percentage","fixed_amount","free_shipping"]},"value":{"type":"number"},"expires_at":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"campaign_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["prefix","quantity","discount_type"]},"request":"Generate 500 unique single-use codes starting with SPRING-, each worth $15 off, for our spring mailer."},
{"name":"get_discount_code_usage","description":"Shows how often a discount code has been redeemed, with total discount given, revenue from orders using it and remaining uses. Use it to check a code's performance or whether it is exhausted.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"code":{"type":"string"},"from_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"to_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},"required":["code"]},"request":"How many times has the code INFLUENCER15 been used and how much revenue did it bring in?"},
{"name":"deactivate_discount_code","description":"Disables a discount code so it can no longer be redeemed, while keeping its history. Use it for leaked or expired codes.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"code":{"type":"string"},"reason":{"type":"string"}},"required":["code"]},"request":"The code FREESHIP99 leaked on a coupon site, switch it off please."},
{"name":"void_discount_redemption","description":"Reverses the redemption of a discount code on a specific order, restoring the code's use for that customer. It does not refund money or change the order itself; use it when a code was applied by mistake or the order was cancelled.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"code":{"type":"string"},"order_id":{"type":"string"},"restore_usage":{"type":"boolean","description":"Give the use back to the customer and the code's usage counter"}},"required":["code","order_id"]},"request":"Order #10482 was cancelled, so release the WELCOME10 redemption on it so the customer can use that code again."},
{"name":"create_campaign","description":"Creates a marketing campaign that groups posts, promotions, discount codes and emails under one name, budget and date range for tracking. Use it before launching a coordinated push.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"objective":{"type":"string","enum":["awareness","traffic","sales","retention"]},"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"budget":{"type":"number"},"channels":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["instagram","facebook","tiktok","email","google_ads","influencer"]}}},"required":["name","objective","start_date"]},"request":"Create a sales campaign called Back to School 2025 running Aug 15 to Sep 10 with a $3,000 budget across Instagram and email."},
{"name":"get_campaign_results","description":"Returns the results of one campaign: spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, attributed revenue, ROAS and cost per acquisition. Use it to report on how a campaign performed.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"campaign_id":{"type":"string"},"group_by":{"type":"string","enum":["none","channel","day","week"]}},"required":["campaign_id"]},"request":"Give me the results for the Back to School 2025 campaign, with ROAS broken down by channel."},
{"name":"compare_campaigns","description":"Compares two or more campaigns side by side on chosen metrics such as revenue, ROAS, conversion rate and cost per acquisition. Use it to decide which campaign to repeat or stop.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"campaign_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"minItems":2},"metrics":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["spend","revenue","roas","conversion_rate","cpa","clicks"]}}},"required":["campaign_ids"]},"request":"Compare our Mother's Day and Father's Day campaigns on ROAS and cost per acquisition."},
{"name":"list_campaign_attributed_orders","description":"Lists orders attributed to a campaign via tracked links or codes, with order value and discount used. Use it to audit which sales a campaign actually drove; it is read-only and does not modify orders.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"campaign_id":{"type":"string"},"from_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"to_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":500},"cursor":{"type":"string"}},"required":["campaign_id"]},"request":"Show me the orders that were credited to the Back to School 2025 campaign last week."},
{"name":"send_campaign_email_to_segment","description":"Sends or schedules a promotional email to a saved audience segment as part of a campaign, using a chosen template and optional discount code. Use it for newsletters and promo blasts to groups of subscribers.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"campaign_id":{"type":"string"},"segment_id":{"type":"string"},"template_id":{"type":"string"},"subject":{"type":"string"},"discount_code":{"type":"string"},"send_at":{"type":"string","format":"date-time","description":"Omit to send immediately"}},"required":["campaign_id","segment_id","template_id","subject"]},"request":"Email the VIP customers segment with template tpl_sale_01, subject 'Early access: 24 hours before everyone else', and include code VIPEARLY, sending tomorrow at 8am."}
]}
